services_page.hero_title: Full support, from sourcing to delivery
services_page.hero_text: At EURL Nexova Trade, we handle every step of your export project so you can count on peace of mind, compliance and speed.
services_page.approach_text1: From product selection to delivery at your door, EURL Nexova Trade acts as a single partner: one point of contact, full visibility at every step, and clear commitments on timelines and quality.
services_page.approach_text2: We work with rigorously selected producers in Algeria and tailor every service to the size and requirements of your market.
services_page.sourcing_text: We identify and select the best local producers and suppliers, based on your quality and volume requirements.
services_page.sourcing_point1: Audit and selection of partner producers
services_page.quality_text: Every batch is inspected and tested before shipment to ensure compliance with international standards.
services_page.quality_point1: Visual, physico-chemical and microbiological inspection depending on the product
services_page.logistics_text: We organize sea, air and land transport, with tracking all the way to destination.
services_page.logistics_point1: Choosing the transport mode best suited to your product
services_page.logistics_point2: Shipment tracking and alerts in case of the unexpected
services_page.customs_text: We handle all export documents, certificates and customs procedures on your behalf.
services_page.customs_point1: Preparation of origin, sanitary and phytosanitary certificates
services_page.customs_point2: Coordination with freight forwarders and export customs
services_page.partnership_text: We facilitate exchanges between producers and international buyers, with full transparency.
services_page.partnership_point1: Direct matchmaking between producer and buyer
services_page.partnership_point2: Negotiating commercial terms in your interest
services_page.support_text: Our team stays available after delivery to answer any question or additional need.
services_page.support_point1: Dedicated point of contact after delivery
services_page.why1_text: You follow your project with one contact, from the first exchange to final delivery.
services_page.why2_text: We only work with audited partners able to meet their volume and quality commitments.
services_page.why3_text: You receive regular updates on production and shipping progress.
services_page.why4_text: Small or large quantities, one-off or recurring orders: we adapt our support to your needs.
services_page.sectors_text: Our services adapt to each of our product families.
services_page.step1_text: You share your needs, and we explore the possibilities together.
services_page.step2_text: We identify the best products and send you a detailed offer.
services_page.step3_text: We monitor production and carry out the necessary quality checks.
services_page.step4_text: We organize transport and support you through to receipt.
services_page.faq1_q: What is the minimum order volume you accept?
services_page.faq1_a: It depends on the product; we review every request, from small trial batches to full container loads.
services_page.faq2_q: How long does a first shipment take?
services_page.faq2_a: Generally between 3 and 8 weeks, depending on the product, availability and the transport mode chosen.
services_page.faq3_q: Do you handle customs formalities on both sides?
services_page.faq3_a: We manage all export procedures in Algeria; on arrival, we guide you according to your country's requirements.
services_page.faq4_q: Can I request samples before ordering?
services_page.faq4_a: Yes, sending samples is part of our standard validation process before ordering.
services_page.cta_title: Have an export project in mind?
services_page.cta_text: Let's talk. Our team replies within 24 business hours.

about_page.hero_text: An Algerian company specialized in export, committed to promoting quality local products in international markets.
about_page.intro_text1: EURL Nexova Trade connects markets and promotes Algerian know-how internationally. Since our founding, we have supported producers and foreign partners in building lasting, reliable and mutually beneficial trade relationships.
about_page.intro_text2: Our team combines in-depth knowledge of the local market with a strong grasp of international market requirements, allowing us to offer products that meet the strictest standards.

footer.brand_text: EURL Nexova Trade connects markets and promotes quality Algerian products internationally.
